displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E2.3
meaning: 1st stage gas valve not energized: it failed 10 times in the same call for heat. The service facts say 24 VAC was not sensed on MVL those 10 times.
causes: 24 VAC not sensed on the 1st stage gas valve (MVL) ten times in one heat call
diySteps: Do not jumper the gas valve to force heat
Technician: the troubleshooting step for fault 2.3 is to replace the integrated furnace control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E2.3 is the gas-valve circuit after ten misses. It is not retry lockout E2.1.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
